title: ECL provision requirement around ₹5k cr, no impact on profitability: PNB MD
description:
Punjab National Bank (PNB) may require an additional provision of around Rs 5,000 crore upon migration to the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework of RBI from April 1, 2027, but the transition is unlikely to have any significant impact on profitability or capital position, the bank's MD and CEO Ashok Chandra said.
The bank had initially estimated an ECL provision requirement of Rs 9,000-10,000 crore based on preliminary manual calculations.
However, a detailed assessment using a digital system has brought down the estimated requirement to around Rs 8,000 crore, Chandra told PTI in an interview.
The reduction of around Rs 1,000-1,500 crore reflects the bank's sound underwriting standards over the past six years, he added.
